observation: SMI has regular membership for North American spring manufacturers and associate membership for suppliers; staff contact applicants after they complete the application. Member Login is already offered.
subject: Nexora demo for SMI's membership applications
text:
Hi Gary,

I noticed SMI has separate memberships for spring manufacturers and suppliers, with staff following up after an application.

We've built Nexora to connect member-company records, employee contacts, membership applications, staff review and member self-service in one system. SMI already has a member login; we'd like to explore whether a focused evaluation of one application workflow would be useful.

An optional AI assistant can also be enabled inside the CRM, so staff can use AI assistance alongside their membership work.

I've attached a 90-second narrated demo with captions.

Would a 15-minute look at that workflow be useful?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com
